room_description: A modern living room with beige walls, a patterned brown and gold rug, a wooden door, a desk with a laptop, a potted plant, a wooden glass-paneled display cabinet, and a white sofa.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the living room.
Checking the laptop on the desk, which requires a text password.
Zooming into the potted plant to find a hidden key.
Approaching the lower wooden cabinet doors.
Unlocking the cabinet and finding a piece of paper.
Examining the paper to read the word 'TAKI'.
Entering 'TAKI' into the laptop's password prompt.
Laptop screen displaying the numeric code '1886'.
Finding a wooden box with a digital keypad inside the upper cabinet.
Using the keycard on the electronic door lock.

solution_steps: Investigate the soil base of the potted plant near the desk.
Use the silver key to unlock the bottom doors of the wooden display cabinet.
Retrieve and examine the paper inside.
Go to the laptop on the desk.
Type the password 'TAKI' using the keyboard.
Open the upper section of the wooden cabinet.
Interact with the digital keypad on the wooden box.

final_action: The player inserts the retrieved keycard into the electronic lock on the main wooden door to unlock it and escape.
